notes.summary: Continuous PC is exactly page convexity plus one common ambient support at every real H point. The full-affine global rational-spatial primal foundation is reconstructed.
notes.detailedSummary: The proof uses inherited feasible midpoint density, perspective feasible density for real PCC, a strict quadratic maximum, full convex Lipschitz derivatives, and separation of compact product subdifferentials from the closed entire restriction image. Full-affine majorants have global error, prescribed rational contacts, actual recession and genuine rational projected faces despite real heights. Neither normal independence nor automatic raw-PC continuity is used.
notes.text:
Translate a rational H point to zero and set E=sum L_i. At a feasible point of a rational polyhedron, impose every active inequality as an equality. Gaussian elimination gives a rational particular solution and rational kernel basis. Approximating the real kernel coordinates rationally stays feasible because every inactive inequality has positive slack. This proves density in the minimal face without carrier coarsening. For a legal PCC discard zero weights and use perspective variables (alpha_i,t_i=alpha_i x_i). The cell inequalities become A_i t_i≥alpha_i b_i, together with sum alpha_i=1 and sum t_i in the center face. These are rational linear constraints. Rational feasible approximants eventually have positive weights and rational endpoints t_i/alpha_i; continuity passes their printed inequalities to the real legal PCC.

At a page point x, its minimal inherited face tau has a neighborhood avoiding all finitely many nonincident closed cells. Nearby x±u lie in incident page cells. The rational feasible system z in tau, z±v in those cells, z,v in L_i supplies legal rational midpoint triples converging to (x,u). Thus continuous PC gives local midpoint convexity. On an arbitrary segment subtract its chord to obtain q with zero endpoint values. If q is positive internally, q+epsilon t², for epsilon sufficiently small, has an interior maximum. The local midpoint inequality makes its symmetric endpoint average exceed this maximum by epsilon s², a contradiction. Hence every entire-page restriction is convex.

A finite convex function on a whole vector space is locally Lipschitz: cube vertex values bound it above; reflection through the center bounds it below on a smaller cube; extending secants a fixed distance bounds both difference quotients. Its directional derivative h_i is finite continuous sublinear by secant monotonicity, the Lipschitz estimate, rescaling and convexity at 2t v and 2t w. Nearest-point separation below a closed epigraph supplies affine supports. At a full-domain graph point the limiting inward unit normal has positive vertical component: a zero vertical component would force its spatial component to vanish. Applied to sublinear h_i, tests at 0 and 2w force support intercept zero. Consequently K_i=partial f_i(y) is nonempty compact convex and h_i(w)=max over K_i of ell(w).

Let K=product K_i and S=image(E*→product L_i*). S is a closed linear subspace even with tangent overlaps. If K misses S, minimizing the squared norm of its perpendicular projection gives a nonzero a with <a,z>≥||a||² for every z in K. Represent −a by page vectors w_i. Orthogonality to S gives sum w_i=0, while sum h_i(w_i)=max_K sum ell_i(w_i)≤−||a||². For small t the endpoints y+t w_i have barycenter y and negative total function increment. Their cells are incident to y's minimal face; perspective density gives the same legal real PCC, contradicting PC. Thus K meets S and one ambient p supports all pages at every real y in H. Conversely, page Jensen applies to centers outside H because their incident cells belong to their unique page. At a center in H, summing the common ambient supporting inequalities cancels the linear barycenter term. This proves every PCC. Shared trace alone is insufficient.

For the full-affine foundation write the actual convex reference gamma=max_j(a_j(x)+b_j), h=max_j a_j(x), Delta=conv{a_j}. Carrier recession cones cover every direction: an unbounded ray has a subsequence in one of finitely many cells. On each recession cone h is that cell's slope. Positive recession makes cells pointed and puts zero in the interior of Delta. Finite rational spatial recession generators lifted with actual real heights h(r), together with the upward ray, generate exactly epi h.

For |f−gamma| bounded, phi=f* has domain exactly Delta. The inequality p(x)≤h(x) bounds phi there; strict spatial separation makes it infinite outside. It is convex LSC and finite on the whole polytope. Such a function is continuous even at boundary points: at x every active inequality permits the direction toward nearby feasible z; choose a fixed radius below all inactive slacks. Convexity bounds phi(z) above by phi(x) plus O(||z−x||) times its finite vertex upper bound, while LSC gives the opposite limiting inequality. Compactness gives uniform continuity.

Choose finitely many rational samples covering all of Delta so g_A(p)=max_a(p(a)−f(a)) lies between phi−eta and phi; append any prescribed finite rational contacts. Define E_A=conv{(a,f(a))}+epi h. Affine-dependency elimination reduces hull combinations to at most dimension+1 terms, proving compactness. Conic dependency elimination reduces representations to independent generators, proving finite cones closed. Thus E_A is closed. Its projection is the entire page; convexity and f(x+v)≤f(x)+h(v) place it above epi f. Its finite lower function F_A has conjugate g_A on Delta and infinity outside. Full-domain supporting-plane biconjugacy gives f≤F_A≤f+eta globally and exact appended contacts. The global bound gives exact actual recession.

Every lower graph face is generated by subsets of rational spatial samples and rational ray positions, with real heights. Its projection is a rational hull/cone. Projection is affine and injective on a graph face; intersections project to common faces. These form a genuine finite rational carrier. Matching equations on shared faces have a rational kernel basis. Clearing slope denominators makes each basis function literal integral-slope PA with rational constants, so the actual real coefficient vector belongs to the genuine real scalar extension. No slope rounding or irrational maximum-wall assertion occurs.

These are mathematical proof claims using ordinary real completeness, finite-dimensional compactness, linear algebra, convex secants and the explicit separation arguments. Artifacts: Sections 2–4 of P05.1-paper.tex and argument.md.

notes.summary: The joint compact dual has simultaneous minima in every trace fiber, including boundary fibers. Lowering them preserves one common ambient support.
notes.detailedSummary: Common support proves G=phi*≤f_i and G|H=f_H. Compact fiber minimization and closed-convex biconjugacy give k=f_H* and T(D)=Delta_H. Each separate page fiber minimum equals k, so every joint minimizer minimizes ALL pages. Compact-hull lowering produces global f_i≤F_i≤f_i+eta, exact whole trace g and shared supports. Intermediate F_i receive no MA.
notes.text:
Use the full-affine and common-support results of n2. Each phi_i=f_i* is finite continuous on the whole actual compact Delta_i, possibly irrational. With restriction maps r_i:E*→L_i* and T:E*→H*, set D={p:r_i p in Delta_i for all i} and phi=max_i phi_i(r_i p). D is a closed finite real polyhedron. An unbounded sequence, normalized and passed to a subsequence, would give a unit form annihilating every L_i because its restrictions stay bounded. Since E=sum L_i, this is impossible. Thus D is compact. A common supporting p_y belongs to D and satisfies phi_i(r_i p_y)=p_y(y)−f_H(y) on every page. D is nonempty and phi is continuous convex.

G=phi* satisfies G(x)≤f_i(x) on page i because phi≥phi_i∘r_i. Common Fenchel equality gives G(y)=f_H(y) for every y in H. No equality outside H is claimed. Set k(q)=min over p in D with Tp=q of phi(p). Compact fibers attain minima; mixing proves convexity. A compact subsequence of minimizers along a lower-limit sequence proves LSC. The polytope boundary argument of n2 gives continuity on the entire T(D). Grouping suprema by fibers gives k*=G|H=f_H.

Extend k by infinity outside T(D). For q in its domain and t<k(q), strict nearest-point separation below epi k gives a normal (A,beta), beta≥0. Testing the epigraph point (q,k(q)) in the SAME spatial fiber gives beta(k(q)−t)>0, hence strictly beta>0. Division produces an affine minorant taking value greater than t at q; taking t upward proves k**=k, including boundary points. Outside the compact domain, a spatial separator u with u(q)>max_domain u makes (s u)(q)−k*(s u) tend to infinity. Thus k=f_H* as an extended closed convex function and T(D)=Delta_H including every boundary fiber.

For each page repeat compact fiber attainment, mixing, LSC and this biconjugacy for U_i:L_i*→H*. Its separate minimum k_i has conjugate f_i|H=f_H and therefore equals k, with the same entire domain. Every p in D consequently has phi_i(r_i p)≥k(Tp). If p jointly minimizes their maximum at q, that maximum is k(q), so ALL individual values equal k(q). The compact set M={p:phi(p)=k(Tp)} surjects onto every q in Delta_H. This is equality from one ambient minimizer, not unrelated page minimizers.

For finite convex g with f_H≤g≤f_H+eta and exact trace recession, b=g* is continuous on all Delta_H and k−eta≤b≤k. Define S_i={(r_i p,b(Tp)):p in M} and E_i=conv(graph phi_i union S_i)+vertical-up. The source is compact. Finite affine-dependency elimination reduces every convex combination to at most ambient dimension+1 terms, proving its hull compact; compact-plus-closed-ray is closed. Its finite attained lower boundary psi_i is closed convex on all Delta_i. Sources lie above phi_i−eta; the original graph is included; all sources also lie above b∘U_i. Hence phi_i−eta≤psi_i≤phi_i and psi_i≥b∘U_i. For ONE joint p over each q, every added source has height b(q), so psi_i(r_i p)=b(q) for ALL pages. All page fiber minima equal b, including boundary fibers.

Set F_i=psi_i*. They are finite continuous convex, have f_i≤F_i≤f_i+eta globally, exact page recession, and F_i|H=b*=g. At any real y in H, compactness attains g(y)=q(y)−b(q). Choose ONE p in M over that q. For every page and every x, F_i(x)≥p(x)−b(q)=g(y)+p(x−y). The same ambient p supports all F_i. By n2 their gluing is PC. They need not be PA and receive no MA.

The argument permits dependent directions and arbitrary continuous nonseparable convex trace data. It uses one common H for every restriction. Artifacts: Sections 5–6 of P05.1-paper.tex and argument.md.

notes.summary: Whole-trace rational PA extension gives global decreasing approximants with the same actual reference; every unrestricted C_b envelope enters the domain before MA.
notes.detailedSummary: Appending all trace vertices and exact trace recession forces equality on the whole H, while being above intermediate F_i preserves every shared support. Rational refinements and scalar matching give genuine finite PA PC. Errors≤2eta followed by common 4eta shifts give [4,6]eta and next≤3eta. H=0 is separate. R230 supplies actual envelope continuity; approximation precedes S272.
notes.text:
Use n2–n3. Approximate f_H above by a finite rational-spatial REAL PA convex g with exact trace recession and f_H≤g≤f_H+eta using the full-affine construction relative to the inherited actual reference. Positive recession makes its carrying cells pointed. Each rational cell is its finite rational vertex hull plus rational recession cone; homogenization and finite active-rank elimination prove this generation. Affineness on each cell therefore gives the ENTIRE epi(g) as the hull of all lifted rational vertices, with actual real heights, plus epi(h_H). Convexity and the recession inequality prove the reverse inclusion. Dimension zero has one lift and the upward ray.

Apply n2's primal construction to each intermediate F_i with error eta, appending ALL trace vertices. The resulting epigraph contains their lifts and the exact branch epi(h_i), hence contains epi(g) over H. Thus Q_i|H≤g. Since Q_i≥F_i and F_i|H=g, equality holds on the whole H. Globally f_i≤Q_i≤f_i+2eta. Every common support of F_i remains below Q_i and still touches at every real H point. The gluing is PC by n2. Rational projected graph faces and matching equations give genuine real scalar PA membership.

Cut all carriers by rational ambient hyperplanes whose intersection is H. Refine the induced trace complexes and g's carrier by their common finite rational hyperplanes; extend those equations rationally to E, together with all page-wall equations. Cutting every page by this finite arrangement gives a common rational complex. Distinct pages meet only in H, so their intersections are common faces there. No values change, no carrier is coarsened, and no irrational slope wall is imposed.

For eta_n=2^(−n), n≥1, obtain Q_n with 0≤Q_n−f≤2eta_n globally. Set P_n=Q_n+4eta_n using the SAME constant on every page. Then 4eta_n≤P_n−f≤6eta_n and P_(n+1)−f≤3eta_n<4eta_n≤P_n−f everywhere. Therefore the sequence is genuinely globally decreasing and uniformly convergent, has exact actual recession, and has common relative norm at most ||f−gamma||+3. For H=0 take g=f(0) exactly and append the origin in each page's primal construction. Every original common support survives and the simpler error is≤eta_n. Dependent bouquets require no normal independence.

The positive complete-page sum is balanced: each page's opposite primitive quotient normals cancel in its saturated lattice, separately also at facets in H. Whole R230 from n1 applies to every u in C_b(X), giving the ACTUAL unrestricted endpoint P_gamma(u), continuous PC and |P_gamma(u)−gamma|≤||u||. The explicit construction then places it in the genuine real completion before any completed operator. R230 itself was not treated as PA regularization.

Upper-only and bounded two-sided competitors have the same envelope. For q≤gamma+u and C=||u||, max(q,gamma−C) is PC: use the active center function's PCC inequality and increase its endpoint values to the maximum. It stays below the obstacle, dominates q and lies between gamma−C and gamma+C. This is a competitor argument, not finite rational PA max closure. Raw downward irrational spikes need not be continuous and receive no automatic operator.

This proves the scoped common-H real regularization statement, with the envelope conclusion conditional on the retained grant. It does not close the original classifications. Artifacts: Section 7 of P05.1-paper.tex, argument.md and proof-source-coverage.md.

notes.text:
In R³ take H the t-axis and page normals v1=(0,1,0), v2=(0,0,1), v3=(0,−1,−1), with common tangent (1,0,0). Every pair intersects exactly in H and sum v_i=0. Each page lattice is saturated: on the third plane x=y every integral point is an integral combination of its two displayed vectors; the coordinate pages are immediate. All weights are one. In primitive coordinates use gamma_i=|t|+|s| and f_i=Huber(t)+Huber(s), where Huber(z)=z²/2 for |z|≤1 and |z|−1/2 outside. Its continuous nondecreasing derivative proves convexity, and −1≤f_i−gamma_i≤0. At (t0,0,0), Huber'(t0)dt supports every page because Huber(s)≥0. The reference has the analogous common t support and positive recession. The original endpoint and reference are PC by n2.

Use exactly the samples (0,0),(1,0),(1/2,1/4), with heights 0,1/2,5/32. Their lifted hull plus epi(|t|+|s|) gives finite above-primal convex rational-spatial PA F_i with exact recession. L(t,s)=t/2−3s/8 has all three heights. Its gradient lies in [−1,1]², so it supports the entire generated epigraph and agrees with F_i on the sample triangle.

The whole trace is −t for t≤0, t/2 on [0,1], and t−1/2 for t≥1. Any third-sample coefficient a contributes s=a/4 and height 5a/32; correcting to s=0 costs at least a/4. Replacing this occurrence by equal coefficients of the first two samples preserves its t coordinate and costs a/4 instead of 13a/32, decreasing cost by 5a/32. Thus the third sample is never required in a trace minimizer. The first-two-sample segment with |t| recession gives the displayed entire formula. All page constructions are identical in their coordinates, so their ENTIRE traces agree.

At z=(1/2,0,0), endpoints z+(1/8)v_i average to z. Each has triangle coordinates (1/2,1/8) and barycentrics (1/4,1/4,1/2). Thus its value is 13/64 while F(z)=1/4=16/64, giving equal-weight PCC cost −3/64. A common rational refinement contains the sample triangles and their common first-two-sample H segment. The center belongs to that common face and each endpoint to its assigned triangle, so this is a legal printed PCC with saturated lattices, not merely an ambient average. Any common ambient support would also require p(v_i)≤−3/8, contradicting p(sum v_i)=0. The failed gluing is not PC and receives no MA. The original f has common supports and is regularized by n4.

The exact checker enumerates all 35 candidate dual triples and finds eight feasible epigraph vertices: (−1,−1,0),(−1,1,0),(−3/16,1,0),(1/2,−1,0),(1/2,−3/8,0),(1,−1,1/2),(1,5/8,1/2),(1,1,19/32). Each trace affine form lies below the stated trace by its endpoint values and outer slopes; the three required forms occur. This is a finite entire-trace certificate accompanying the written proof. Each page's lattice minor gcd is one. Exhaustiveness is confined to this stated finite list.

notes.summary: Actual raw positivity, mass/topology restrictions and genuine crossing-contact failure coexist with regularity.
notes.detailedSummary: Complete positive page cycles and their selected-page residual are balanced/effective. Common supports give tangent-corrected divisor positivity on every nonnegative local cycle. Whole BBGS signed/zero calibration precedes S272. Primitive nested-kernel factors yield 2^d d!|det A|. Whole S272/S282 actual-reference realization gives a finite PA roof with negative contact. Completed measures are used only after domain construction, with fixed-C moment and weak/BL restrictions retained.
notes.text:
For c_i>0, [X]=sum c_i[L_i] is positive balanced on every rational refinement: each complete page's facet neighbors have opposite primitive quotient normals and equal weights in its saturated lattice, cancelling separately even along H. Subtracting c_1[L_1] leaves exactly sum_(i≠1)c_i[L_i], an effective balanced residual. This verifies the residual rather than inferring it from support inclusion.

The raw formula is D_a c(tau)=sum_(sigma>tau)c(sigma)a_sigma(n_sigma/tau)−a_tau(sum c(sigma)n_sigma/tau), with translated saturated tangents and inward primitive quotient normals. At every face choose an ambient local support p; its tangent derivative agrees with a_tau. Subtracting p cancels the balanced tangent correction and leaves sum c(sigma)(a_sigma−p)(n_sigma/tau)≥0. Thus every constructed PA function has genuine divisor positivity on ALL nonnegative local balanced cycles and refinements.

For recursive calibration let a_sigma be saturated tangent-lattice covolume, with a_vertex=1. A facet basis followed by a primitive complement gives perpendicular primitive length a_sigma/a_tau. Euclidean weights a_sigma c(sigma) satisfy unit-normal balance, and the BBGS negative-unit product satisfies B_(−f)(a c)(tau)=a_tau D_f c(tau). Embed x as (x,1); tangent metrics remain unchanged. This holds through every recursive dimension for real, signed and zero weights. Whole BBGS 3.12 supplies subdivision. Its 3.15 expands each codimension-two wedge using two boundary unit rays and bisector reflection, pairs cross terms and proves commutation. Lemma 3.18 characterizes balance by annihilation by ambient linear forms, and 3.19 preserves it using the actual 3.15 equality; its printed commutation reference to 3.12 is corrected. No AR10 delegation is used.

On a finite one-cycle bounded PA factors have symmetric edge contribution Z(e)(b(v)−b(w))(c(w)−c(v))/L_e, with primitive lattice length L_e. On unbounded edges bounded affine factors have zero slope. Hence bounded IBP and zero degree of a bounded divisor hold. Replacing mixed relative factors by gamma successively gives exact raw mass M=deg gamma with no appended normalization.

Only after n4 supplies the genuine domain is whole S272 applied to obtain positive finite mixed Radon completion, symmetry, locality, sequence independence and exact mass. For its actual rational component gamma=gamma'+epsilon gamma0, H0=gamma0+c≥0 proper and J0=integral H0 MA(gamma), EVERY completed tuple with max_i||f_i−gamma||≤C satisfies integral H0 MA(tuple)≤(2d/epsilon)CM+J0 and tail mass≤that constant/T. Global uniformity is vague compact-test uniformity. Ordinary weak C_b continuity includes nets; weak C_b/BL uniform continuity is restricted to each fixed-C family. Stronger entire-domain uniformities remain false. Intermediate n3 functions and the failed n5 approximant receive no MA.

At rational v in H choose rational a in L_2 outside L_1. The transverse two-sided line R a meets L_1 only at zero. Extend a saturated dual basis on L_1 to rational ambient forms ell_r vanishing on this line. The ambient convex jet j=sum|ell_r| is rational PA PC and flat in both line directions. Clear denominators of a rational restriction row and use integer Euclidean operations to transform it to (g,0,...,0). Opposite primitive kernel normals give divisor factor 2g, with rational scaling restored; the kernel is saturated. Nested kernel bases and primitive complements form a basis at each step, so successive positive evaluations multiply to |det A|. Each ordered product of the d distinct absolute forms contributes 2^d|det A|. A repeated form restricts to zero after its kernel; a rank-deficient restriction has common lineality and zero top cycle. Exactly d! orders survive for an independent restriction. Therefore m0(j)=2^d d! sum c_i|det A_i|≥c_1 2^d d!>0, with A_1 identity. The factorial arises from raw orders, not appended normalization.

Whole S272/S282 supplies actual-reference realization: the same germ C+t+delta j is built in every rational positive reference summand, whose positive real coefficients sum to one on a common rational refinement. Rational summand maxima have rational walls. Thus F is genuine finite relative REAL PA PC for the SAME actual gamma, remains flat on the line, and has atom delta^d m0(j). For sufficiently small rational R, u=F−gamma+(R−rho(x−v))_+ is bounded genuine real PA. The flat rational boundary PCC bounds every unrestricted competitor at v; radial rational chords bound rational points; shrinking rational face simplices and continuity of F bound real centers. Outside the roof the obstacle equals F. Hence the ACTUAL envelope is F. The roof isolates its center atom and contact integral is exactly −R delta^d m0(j)<0. All cycle, residual, rational line, carrier and primitive antecedents were checked before applying the grants. Contact failure therefore coexists with regularity; general non-PA contact sufficiency is not claimed.

The exact nested-kernel checker exhausts 44 factor orders in six fixed matrices. Raw masses are 3,8,48,20/3,624,0 for determinants 3/2,1,6,5/6,13,0. Surviving counts are 1,2,2,2,6,0. Each nonzero ordered contribution is 2^d|det A|. These finite examples illustrate, rather than prove, the universal lattice calculation.
